senses.gloss: m. pl. (ספל, v. סֵפֶל) scrapings, esp. [scraped] date-stones used as fodder (eventually as fuel).
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 11a:14">B. Bath. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>פירא דס׳</he> a pit where offal is deposited for fodder.

<cite ref="Gittin 69b:19">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>מיא דס׳</he> water in which date-stones have been soaked; a. e.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:3">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:3">XVI</cite>), 3 <he>סופלי של שמן</he>, v. <cite ref="O01381"><he>סֵפֶל</he></cite>.]
